phase: ROADMAP Stage 6 (final item): dependency inventory / SBOM / optional-container skeleton v1 (stdlib-first, zero runtime deps). Completes the Stage 6 deterministic skeletons.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 6 supply-chain skeleton plus repo-local metadata files. build_dependency_inventory declares the project as stdlib-first with zero third-party runtime dependencies; validate_dependency_inventory requires pinned versions and rejects credential fields. build_sbom_document emits a deterministic, timestamp-free CycloneDX-like SBOM of first-party components; validate_sbom_document checks project/version/components. build_container_deploy_plan describes an optional offline-first container (never builds or pushes); validate_container_deploy_plan checks base image/port/steps. build_supply_chain_summary bundles all three. New committed files: requirements.txt (comments only, no third-party pins), docs/sbom.json (kept in sync with the helper, asserted by test), and an optional Containerfile with no RUN/install step. HTTP GET /api/supply-chain/sbom and a 设置 panel status. No dependency install, no image build/push, no network/registry, no credential/.env read.
implemented: backend/server.py: build_dependency_inventory/validate_dependency_inventory (stdlib-first, zero runtime deps; validator requires pinned name+version and rejects credential fields).
backend/server.py: build_container_deploy_plan/validate_container_deploy_plan (optional offline-first plan; never builds/pushes; port/image/steps checks).
backend/server.py: build_supply_chain_summary bundling inventory+SBOM+container plan; Handler.do_GET serves GET /api/supply-chain/sbom.
requirements.txt: comments only (no third-party pins) documenting Python>=3.12 and the pinning rule if a dep is ever added.
docs/sbom.json: committed deterministic SBOM, asserted by test to equal build_sbom_document() output.
Containerfile: optional offline-first skeleton with COPY/EXPOSE/CMD and no RUN or pip install (not built or pushed by any gate).
frontend/index.html + app.js: 设置 panel supply-chain section with #loadSbomBtn/#sbomStatus and loadSbom() calling /api/supply-chain/sbom.

tests/test_supply_chain.py: 18 tests (inventory deterministic/stdlib-only, unpinned-dep rejection, SBOM validity/determinism/no-timestamp/no-secrets, committed-file-in-sync, container defaults/invalid-port, requirements/Containerfile/no-secret file checks, live HTTP sbom, frontend tokens).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_supply_chain.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; the ROADMAP '依赖锁定、软件物料清单和可选容器部署' item is marked done and a Stage 6 skeleton-status note keeps the boundary honest.
not_implemented: No dependency install or package-manager invocation; the inventory is declared metadata.
No container image build, tag, or push; the Containerfile is a skeleton not exercised by any gate.
No external/transitive dependency scan, registry access, or vulnerability lookup.
test_status: python -m unittest tests.test_supply_chain -v: 18 tests OK (includes live ThreadingHTTPServer sbom and committed docs/sbom.json in-sync assertion).
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 431 tests OK.
python tools/run_quality_gates.py --json (default 'python' on PATH): passed=true, all 5 gates passed (secret-scan clean over new files); unittest gate ran 431 tests OK.
risks: docs/sbom.json is committed and must stay in sync with build_sbom_document(); a test asserts equality, so bumping PROJECT_VERSION requires regenerating the file or the suite fails (intentional guard).
The SBOM lists first-party components only; it is not a transitive/vulnerability scan and must not be treated as a security attestation.
The dependency inventory is declared, not discovered: if a third-party import is added without updating the inventory, validation will not automatically catch it.
The Containerfile is a skeleton; it is not built or scanned by CI, so image-level correctness/security is unverified here.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; inventory/SBOM validators reject credential-shaped fields and a test scans the new files for secret tokens.
No external network calls, registry access, or dependency installs were used for implementation or local tests.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
